SCI.basis: The actual SVG starts at (v=0,m=m0), not O. Its normalized samples at v/c=0.5, 0.8 and 0.9 are 1.1547005383, 1.6666666666 and 2.2941573387. All 1472 vertices obey the authoritative relation m=m0/sqrt(1-v^2/c^2), with monotonic growth for nonnegative speed and no point at or beyond c. Current corrected bilingual prose and the visible title explicitly identify m as relativistic mass; the lower note identifies m0 as invariant rest mass.
SCI.cutoff: The final drawn vertex has v/c=0.9928885458108109 and m/m0=8.4, solely an unlabelled drawing cutoff just above the source's last 8m0 tick. It has no endpoint marker and is not an asserted maximum or a value at c. The visible note states that c is a limit, not a curve point.
SCI.conditions: A massive body in the chosen inertial frame, speed 0<=v<c. The graph does not imply changing invariant rest mass, graph values above c, a finite mass at c, or a generally valid acceleration F/m. Corrected accelerator examples remain prose; no 100x or 2000x source-data points have been invented.

One common orthogonal frame, O below-left, upward/rightward arrowheads, all eight mass tick labels, all nine interior speed ticks, 0.5c and c are preserved. Neutral and accent screenshots are nonblank and legible.
